newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn, wheat values unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn, wheat values unchanged.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, wheat and soybean offers began the week unchanged in what exporters characterized as a very quiet market.
"For the U.S., nothing is going on in the soybean market," an exporter said. "Taiwan is in tonight, but that is all."
Taiwan was expected to tender for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans Tuesday for delivery from the U.S. Gulf March 1-15 or from the Pacific Northwest March 16-31, traders said.
Wheat exporters said they were not surprised that the Egyptian government bought Australian hard wheat rather than U.S. at a weekend tender for 110,000 tonnes.
U.S. wheat prices are still not considered competitive with those of other exporting nations, cash sources said.
